q: Choose the sentence in the Future Continuous Tense.
o: She will write a letter tomorrow.
She will be writing a letter tomorrow.
She will have writing a letter tomorrow.

q: Which sentence correctly follows the 'Present Perfect Continuous' rule?
o: They work here for five years.
They are working here since five years.
They worked here for five years.
They have been working here for five years.

q: Two weeks have passed since she _____ the new company.
Fill in the blank: While I —— through the park, I met an old friend.
e:
একটি দীর্ঘস্থায়ী অতীত কাজের মধ্যে আরেকটি ছোট কাজ ঘটলে দীর্ঘ কাজটি Past Continuous হয়, আর ছোট কাজটি Simple Past। এখানে 'met' ছোট কাজ, তাই হাঁটার কাজটি 'was walking'।
মনে রাখুন:
Past Continuous: was/were + verb-ing
উদাহরণ: While it was raining, we stayed home.

q: As it was raining, I ___ an umbrella.
Choose the right form of verb: I (see) him recently.
The teacher will check the copies after the students _____ writing.
Choose the sentence in Future Continuous Tense.
o: They will play football next week.
They will be playing football at 5 PM.

q: Do not make a noise while your teacher _____ lecture.
Fifty years have passed since man _______ on the moon.
She has just ______ her homework, but she says she will go out after taking a short rest.
The guests had left before we ____ at the party.
She will be eligible for a promotion after ____________ the necessary courses.
She ___ a nurse when she decided to qualify as a doctor.
e: দুটি অতীত ঘটনার মধ্যে নার্স থাকার কাজটি ডাক্তার হওয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার আগে ঘটেছে। আগের কাজের জন্য Past Perfect Tense (had been) বসে, আর পরের কাজ decided Past Indefinite। সঠিক বাক্য 'She had been a nurse when she decided to qualify as a doctor.'। অর্থ: ডাক্তার হওয়ার যোগ্যতা অর্জনের সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার সময় সে নার্স ছিল। has been ও is বর্তমানের রূপ, আর is being বিশেষ অর্থে ব্যবহার হয়। সূত্র: past + past হলে আগেরটি Past Perfect।
